check your mailbox! | november's mail

November's SEARCH snail mail club package is on its way, featuring Orlando artist Xine Hann of Orlando Collage Club and 20% off Florida Coffee Festival tickets.

Monthly Mail November 9, 2026 · 2 min read

mail club · featured artist · local business

Hello friends!

November’s mail package is on its way!! Keep an eye on your mailbox, since unclaimed letters do get sent back to us. If some time has passed and yours still hasn’t shown up, shoot us an email at searchcentralflorida@gmail.com and we’ll get it sorted.

Onto the exciting stuff, here’s what’s waiting in your mailbox this month!

Featured artist: Xine Hann

This month’s featured artist is Xine Hann! Xine is a mom, graphic designer, and the founder and director of Orlando Collage Club; you may have already been to one of their events! Make sure to head over to @xine_hann on Instagram to show your support, and if you haven’t made it to a Collage Club event yet, definitely check one out!

Featured business: Florida Coffee Festival

Inside your package you’ll also find an exclusive offer from this month’s featured business, Florida Coffee Festival! Use the promotion code in your mail to get 20% off general admission tickets when you buy online. The third annual festival brings together local coffee shops, roasters, matcha brands, and specialty drink makers for a full day of sampling, plus coffee cuppings, goat cuddling (yes, really), the Florida Latte Art Championship, live music, and local artist and chef pop-ups. Come find your next favorite café and celebrate the spaces where so much of Central Florida’s creative community comes together.

Florida Coffee Festival | Saturday, November 15th, 11:00am–4:00pm | Festival Park, Orlando
Read more about the festival · See it on our events calendar

None of this happens without you. Every subscription puts real support behind local artists and small businesses across Central Florida, and we’re always looking for ways to make SEARCH: a snail mail club more worth your while. Thank you for making supporting local a part of your monthly routine!

If you are new here, every month we highlight a local artist and business right here in central florida. Join the club today!

let's chat again soon!

-SEARCH <3
